column7: 2026-11-06: Open decision (user's): whether percent-encoding for inject() values belongs in regexparam or in their uploader client. Do not add encoding to regexparam until they decide. Finding: plain encodeURIComponent does NOT match the storage service's signed path, because it leaves ! ' ( ) * unescaped and the service encodes them (%21 %27 %28 %29). Wildcard (*) values need per-segment encoding so / stays.

2026-11-06: User asked for percent-encoding in regexparam inject() (resolves the earlier open decision): implemented with encodeURIComponent plus ! ' ( ) * -> %XX to match the storage service's signed path; wildcard values encoded per segment keeping '/'. Tests added in test/inject.js.
